item.title: Gekka no Kirameki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Circle Mebius
  • 発売日: 2007-12-24
  • スコア: 6.85/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 月下之煌
  • 英語名: Gekka no Kirameki

あらすじ

There is a small independent country " Seikoku" located in remote mountains. Main character gets attacked by a zombie one night. Then a large army of the dead comes under the walls. Among protagonist’s troops one girl is found out to manipulate zombies. A way to oppose this huge undead threat must be found with any means possible.

あらすじ

Stage is abandoned city. Many abandoned children live here on their own, and angels controls the order there.

Main character is a lonely boy who is taken care of by the church. He has a girl Karen as a friend, so he lives quite a happy life. But one day protagonist receives magic power from the Father. However, there is a side effect to using that power…

别名

  • komakoi

あらすじ

Main character has been working in an antique shop for ten years since childhood. He believes that there should be only laughter in this world, but no sadness. One day he overhears a story about a girl living in an old temple outside the town. This very evening he approaches this building and finds young girl inside.

item.title: Natsu no Tomoshibi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Circle Mebius
  • 発売日: 2004-06-06
  • スコア: 6.590000000000001/10 (20 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 夏の燈火
  • 英語名: Natsu no Tomoshibi

あらすじ

One day a young boy arrived at this village, holding a letter in one hand and his sister’s hand in the other.

They had no place left to go but the address written in the letter he was holding. Since they traveled with one-way tickets, there was no way back.

In the end, they were accepted as a part of the family living at the address written in the message, and started their new life in the village.

item.title: Time ~Hohoemi no Mukou ni~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Circle Mebius
  • 発売日: 2000-05-21
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Time ～微笑みの向こうに～
  • 英語名: Time Hohoemi no Mukou ni

あらすじ

Today, at the usual time, a girl wakes me up and stuffs my bag with textbooks and notebooks (…)

“Good morning, master…”

That was my sister, Hotsuki, dressed in a maid’s outfit… Time flows.

The changing seasons and the unchanging thoughts… What is the truth hidden in the maid clothes? A scenario-oriented, pure love adventure game.
